description: tools.byAgent for an agent a person made or imported (a CUSTOM agent): `dispatchable:true`, because it is an agent like any other — the person who brought it in answers for it, and what lets it call a tool is the policy rule written when the tool was chosen, not a class of agent that never runs. Its row's tools are judged by the engine exactly as a shipped agent's are: `read` has the allow rule its owner's grant wrote (`granted_allowed`), `grep` is on the row with no rule yet (`granted_no_rule` — silence permits nothing, PL5, which is a different fact from a denial), and `todo` is not on the row (`not_granted`, with no reason because none was sought). `granted_by` still names where each held tool came from.

tools.reason: refused: no policy rule matched this tool for this agent — silence permits nothing (PL5)
